//! `greeting`: one module per command.

pub mod list;
pub mod show;

/// The `greeting` commands.
#[derive(clap::Subcommand)]
pub enum GreetingCommand {
    List(list::command::ListArguments),
    Show(show::command::ShowArguments),
}

/// Runs one `greeting` command with the edge the command tree built.
pub fn run(command: GreetingCommand, edge: &crate::edge::Edge) -> crate::outcome::Outcome {
    match command {
        GreetingCommand::List(arguments) => list::command::run(arguments, edge),
        GreetingCommand::Show(arguments) => show::command::run(arguments, edge),
    }
}
